title: Analytic cyclic orbit product, order, and invariance
statement: Let w be a positive natural number, let ζ∈ℂ satisfy ζ^w=1, and let A:ℂ→ℂ be analytic at zero with analyticOrderAt A 0≠⊤. Define P(t)=∏_{j=0}^{w−1}A(ζ^j t). Then P is analytic at zero, analyticOrderAt P 0≠⊤, analyticOrderNatAt P 0=w·analyticOrderNatAt A 0, and P(ζt)=P(t) for every t∈ℂ.
lean_statement: ∀ (w : ℕ) (ζ : ℂ) (A : ℂ → ℂ), 0 < w → ζ ^ w = 1 → AnalyticAt ℂ A 0 → analyticOrderAt A 0 ≠ ⊤ → let P : ℂ → ℂ := fun t => ∏ j ∈ Finset.range w, A (ζ ^ j * t); AnalyticAt ℂ P 0 ∧ analyticOrderAt P 0 ≠ ⊤ ∧ analyticOrderNatAt P 0 = w * analyticOrderNatAt A 0 ∧ ∀ t : ℂ, P (ζ * t) = P t
